C0627.title: Woman Racks Up Over 400,000 Yuan in Debt via Phone Rentals; Police Crack First 'Rent-to-Loan' Illegal Business Case
C0627.summary: In July 2024, Shanghai police cracked the first case of illegal lending disguised as 'phone rentals.' Ms. Jiang, through loan intermediary Wu, used multiple mobile apps to obtain funds by renting phones and reselling them for cash, involving illicit transactions exceeding 20 million yuan. Fifteen suspects were arrested.

references.title: Woman Rents Phone for Cash-Out, Ends Up Over 400,000 Yuan in Debt; Police Crack First 'Rent-to-Loan' Illegal Business Case
